column2: On Individual basis - SI shall apply to each individual family member On Floater basis - SI shall apply to the entire family INR

Policy can be availed for Self and the following family members i. legally wedded spouse. Policy can be availed by persons between the age of 18 years and 65years, as Proposer. Proposer with higher age can obtain policy for family, without covering self. Dependent Children (i.e. natural or legally adopted) between the age 3 months to 25 years. If the child above 18 years of age is financially independent, he or she shall be ineligible for coverage in the subsequent renewals ii. Parents and Parents-in-law .
For Yearly payment of mode, a fixed period of 30 days is to be allowed as Grace Period and for all other modes of payment a fixed period of 15 days be allowed as grace period.
